headline: Haryana bank scam: chargesheet filed against six IAS officers, CBI makes several sensational revelations | Haryana Bank Scam CBI Chargesheet 6 IAS Bureaucrats Financial Irregularities Corruption Special Court Chandigarh
summary: The CBI chargesheet in the IDFC and AU Small Finance Bank case alleges financial irregularities and names six IAS officers. The case is before a special court in Chandigarh.
why: IDFC First Bank and AU Small Finance Bank are Indian lenders, and fraud cases involving them can affect regulatory scrutiny and investor confidence in the sector.
